rows.text: Clockie is here to serve you, tick-tock! Would you like to hear me introduce my friends, tick-tock?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Brother Hanu is my most reliable companion, tick-tock! Not only did he take me and Mr. Soda to Clock Diner for a feast, he even invited us to the Grand Theater for a recital, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Although, I don't really understand such elegant things and I fell asleep halfway through, haha! But, I was really happy, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Mr. Soda is my good friend, tick-tock! He is hard-working, intelligent, and really kind. Whenever he has leftovers, he leaves them for me and doesn't ask me for money, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: I'm so happy I became brothers with them, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: I have lots of other good friends, too! They are all wonderful people... I'll introduce you to them all when I get an opportunity, okay?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: They will always be my best friends, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie
